Research question: "Does the expression genes in major depressive disorder significantly differs from control looking at the anterior cingulate cortex while adjusting for age?"

Hypotheses:
  H0: There is no difference in gene expression between the major   depressive disorder and the control after correcting for age.
  H1: There is a difference in gene expression between the major depressive disorder and the control after correcting for age.
  
  
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
count_data <- read_csv("C:/Users/louis/Downloads/GSE80655_counts.csv")
metadata <- read_csv("C:/Users/louis/Downloads/GSE80655_metadata.csv")
```
discover data:
```{r}

# Look at the dimensions
dim(metadata)
dim(count_data)

# Look at the first rows
head(metadata)
head(count_data)

# Look at the column names
colnames(metadata)
colnames(count_data)

# Look at the structure
str(metadata)
str(count_data)

# Summerise of data
summary(metadata)

# Look at diagnoses
table(metadata$diagnosis)

# Look at brain regions
table(metadata$brain_region)

```

we select our relevant observations based on the research question:
```{r}

library(dplyr)

metadata_AnCg <- metadata %>%
  filter(
    brain_region == "AnCg",
    diagnosis %in% c("Control", "Major Depression")
  )

# Look at new dataset
dim(metadata_AnCg)

# Controle of the group deviation
table(metadata_AnCg$diagnosis)

# Controle of the brain regions
table(metadata_AnCg$brain_region)

```
--> so this gives how many we have for each group

look if there are any missing values:
```{r}
# Amount of missing values per variable
colSums(is.na(metadata_AnCg))

# Percentage missing values per variable
colMeans(is.na(metadata_AnCg)) * 100
```
controle the age:
```{r}
summary(metadata_AnCg$age)

# Histogram of the age
hist(
  metadata_AnCg$age,
  main = "Age distribution in AnCg",
  xlab = "Age",
  col = "lightblue"
)
```

Are there any outliers for age?
```{r}
boxplot(
  metadata_AnCg$age,
  main = "Age outliers in AnCg",
  ylab = "Age",
  col = "lightblue"
)
```

And is the age comparable between the two groups?
```{r}
boxplot(
  age ~ diagnosis,
  data = metadata_AnCg,
  main = "Age by diagnosis",
  xlab = "Diagnosis",
  ylab = "Age",
  col = c("lightgreen", "lightpink")
)
```

controls for the count data:
```{r}
# Look at the dimensions 
dim(count_data)

# Look at a few values
head(count_data[, 1:6])

# Look at the structure
str(count_data)

# Control if there are negative values
sum(as.matrix(count_data[, -1]) < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

# Control missing values
sum(is.na(count_data))
```



Process to delete missing values:
```{r}
# A copy of count_data
counts <- as.data.frame(count_data)

# gene_id as row name
rownames(counts) <- counts$gene_id

# delete gene_id column
counts$gene_id <- NULL

# Only select samples in metadata_AnCg 
sample_ids <- metadata_AnCg$description

counts_AnCg <- as.matrix(counts[, sample_ids, drop = FALSE])
```

```{r}
# Amount of genes & samples
dim(counts_AnCg)

# Control if samples names are the same
all(colnames(counts_AnCg) == metadata_AnCg$description)

# Look at the first rows
head(counts_AnCg)
```

filtering as criteria in word doc for deleting missing values:
```{r}
# Calculate percentage of NA-values per gene 
na_percentage <- rowMeans(is.na(counts_AnCg)) * 100

# Select genes according to our 2 criteria
keep_genes <- rowSums(counts_AnCg, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &
              na_percentage <= 95

# Make filtered dataset
counts_filtered <- counts_AnCg[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
# Amount of genes & samples before filtering
dim(counts_AnCg)

# Amount of genes & samples before filtering
dim(counts_filtered)

# How many genes are deleted
nrow(counts_AnCg) - nrow(counts_filtered)
```
